e.title: insurance_jupyter (OSM)
e.summary: OSM 精算 Jupyter 教程合集（10★，MIT）：Open Source Modelling 全部精算 Notebook 一站式
e.summary_en: OSM actuarial Jupyter tutorial collection (10★, MIT): all Open Source Modelling actuarial notebooks in one place
e.summary_hk: OSM 精算 Jupyter 教程合集（10★，MIT）：Open Source Modelling 全部精算 Notebook 一站式
e.body: insurance_jupyter（Open Source Modelling，10★，MIT）汇集 OSM 的全部精算 Jupyter Notebook：[[insurance-python]]（OSM 算法库）的教程配套——Smith-Wilson、Nelson-Siegel、Vasicek、Hull-White 等的可运行 Notebook 演示。对 RIAA：精算算法的动手教程——[[insurance-python]] 管算法实现、本仓库管教学演示；利率模型（[[yield-curve]] 主题）的可运行例子；与 [[course]]（burning-cost 12 模块课程）配套；适合自学精算算法的实操环节。
e.body_en: insurance_jupyter (Open Source Modelling, 10★, MIT) collects all OSM actuarial Jupyter Notebooks: the tutorial companion of [[insurance-python]] (OSM algorithm library) — runnable notebook demos of Smith-Wilson, Nelson-Siegel, Vasicek, Hull-White etc. For RIAA: hands-on tutorials of actuarial algorithms — [[insurance-python]] provides the algorithms, this repo provides the teaching demos; runnable examples of rate models ([[yield-curve]] theme); pairs with [[course]] (burning-cost 12-module course); suits the practice stage of self-studying actuarial algorithms.
e.body_hk: insurance_jupyter（Open Source Modelling，10★，MIT）匯集 OSM 的全部精算 Jupyter Notebook：[[insurance-python]]（OSM 算法庫）的教程配套——Smith-Wilson、Nelson-Siegel、Vasicek、Hull-White 等的可運行 Notebook 演示。對 RIAA：精算算法的動手教程——[[insurance-python]] 管算法實現、本倉庫管教學演示；利率模型（[[yield-curve]] 主題）的可運行例子；與 [[course]]（burning-cost 12 模塊課程）配套；適合自學精算算法的實操環節。
